Cricket world reacts to Imran Khan's sons' interview and ex-PM's jail conditions

Former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan's sons, Sulaiman and Kasim Khan, expressed fears for their father's safety and well-being in jail, stating he is "agitated" and suffering from anxiety. Their interview with Sky Sports reportedly angered the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB), which considered withdrawing players from a Test match against England. Separately, cricketers including Pat Cummins, Kapil Dev, and Sunil Gavaskar have signed a petition calling for proper medical care and family access for Imran Khan.
